purpose: Treat quality-equivalent reductions in context, tokens, latency or resource use as real PI effects while preventing cost shifting into wall time, memory, model contention or operational dependencies.

baseline_reference.note: Historical B0b values are a reference snapshot, not a substitute for same-head paired C2 measurements.

quality_hard_gates.rule: Efficiency never compensates for a critical correctness regression.
quality_hard_gates.small_sealed_evaluation: Require no new critical task/oracle failure and no regression in critical-evidence or required-verification recall.
quality_hard_gates.larger_repeated_evaluation: Predeclare a non-inferiority margin before execution; do not derive it from the result.

scoped_tradeoff_latency_budget.condition: Only when quality hard gates pass and there is a strong context/resource gain or the change enables a task that otherwise exceeds the usable context/resource limit.

provisional_effect_thresholds.note: Thresholds are provisional engineering adoption thresholds. Recalibration requires a recorded evidence-based rationale before changing them.

adoption_classes.QUALITY_GAIN: Quality improves materially and added cost is within a predeclared justified budget; KEEP or scoped KEEP.
adoption_classes.EFFICIENCY_GAIN: Quality hard gates pass, at least one meaningful context/token/latency/resource dimension improves, median wall-time regression is <=5%, p95 regression is <=10%, and there is no harmful primary-model contention; counts as a real positive effect.
adoption_classes.FEASIBILITY_GAIN: Quality hard gates pass and a task that previously overflowed/truncated or could not coexist in memory now fits. May justify a scoped mode even with up to the scoped latency budget; do not automatically make it default.
adoption_classes.TRADEOFF: Quality is non-inferior and one cost improves but another exceeds the default budget. Keep OFF_BY_DEFAULT/scoped until optimization or user-specific policy justifies it.
adoption_classes.NO_MATERIAL_EFFECT: Quality is non-inferior but no metric crosses a predeclared meaningful threshold; consolidate/off/defer unless needed as SUBSTRATE_ONLY in a winning bundle.
adoption_classes.REGRESSION: Any quality hard gate fails, or resource/operational harm is unacceptable; reject/default-off regardless of context savings.

resource_reject_conditions: Auxiliary model causes primary coding model eviction/reload in the normal target configuration.
Auxiliary model forces a smaller primary-model context budget that removes the claimed context benefit.
New API/model dependency is required for default operation but is not available/reliable enough for the target environment.
End-to-end median wall-time regression exceeds 15% without a predeclared material quality or feasibility gain.
Any OOM, correctness-critical truncation, privacy regression or false verification is introduced.

order: leave-one-out ablation of a successful bundle
targeted pairwise or higher-order interaction only with a causal rationale
interaction_policy.substrate_rule: A mechanism with null standalone effect may remain SUBSTRATE_ONLY when removing it from a successful bundle causes a quality, coverage, feasibility or meaningful efficiency regression.
interaction_policy.redundancy_rule: If removal preserves quality/coverage and improves context, latency, memory, dependency or maintenance cost, prefer CONSOLIDATE/OFF/REMOVE.

decision_method.forbidden: Do not collapse all dimensions into a single weighted score for adoption.
decision_method.paired_measurement: Prefer same-head, same-task, same-model, same-repetition paired comparisons; record p50/p95 and distributions rather than best-run values.
